title: Bacon and Cheese Quiche
summary: A classic French-style quiche with crisp bacon, a rich egg and cream custard, and plenty of melted cheese. It’s hearty enough for dinner and best served warm with a simple green salad.
steps: Make the pastry: rub the cold butter into the plain flour and salt until the mixture looks like fine breadcrumbs. Stir in the egg and cold water, then bring together into a dough without overworking it.
Shape the dough into a disc, wrap it, and chill for 20 minutes. Heat the oven to 190°C.

Roll out the pastry and line a 23 cm tart tin. Prick the base with a fork, line with baking paper and baking beans if you have them, then blind bake for 15 minutes. Remove the paper and beans and bake for 5 minutes more until pale and dry.
While the pastry bakes, cook the bacon in a dry pan over medium heat until browned and crisp. Add the onion and olive oil, then cook for 5 to 7 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Set aside.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, double cream, milk, black pepper, salt, and nutmeg. Stir in the grated cheddar.
Spread the bacon and onion over the baked pastry case, then pour over the custard mixture.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until the filling is just set with a slight wobble in the centre and the top is golden. Rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
